name: Bhagat Halwai
why_it_matters: Founded 1795 by Lekh Raj Bhagat on the Yamuna bank — one of India's oldest continuously-running sweet shops. Family business across seven generations. Petha, peda, dalmoth, samosa-kachori; the city's default mithai gift box.
insider_tip: Buy petha as a takeaway only from the main Sadar counter — branches in malls turn over slower stock. The dalmoth (savoury lentil mix) keeps for 2 weeks unrefrigerated; better travel gift than petha.
signature_address: Sadar Bazaar Main Market, near Pratapura Crossing, Agra Cantt, Agra 282001

name: Mama Chicken Mama Franky House
why_it_matters: Open-air street kitchen in the heart of Sadar Cantt — a 24-chef line running outdoor tandoors and tawa grills late into the night. The largest non-veg operation Sadar runs, drawing locals after the bazaar shops shut.
insider_tip: Eat outside at the standing counter rather than the indoor seating — the food comes faster and you get to see the tandoor pull-out. Open till midnight, peak crowds 9-11pm.
signature_address: Sadar Bazaar Main Road, Agra Cantt, Agra 282001

name: Dasaprakash
why_it_matters: Established 1921 — the south-Indian-veg outpost in Agra long before that was a category. Still serves the original dosa-thali menu plus an unexpectedly large ice-cream sundae list. Locally also rebranded as Deepee Restaurant.
insider_tip: Sit upstairs for the cleaner section; downstairs is faster but cramped. The sundae pages are the dessert locals come for after a Sadar dinner — order regardless of how full you are.

name: Brijwasi Sweet House & Restaurant
why_it_matters: The Sadar Bazaar Brijwasi (founded 1980) — half mithai counter, half multi-cuisine veg dining. Reliable for North Indian thalis through to dosas in the same kitchen, which is rare for the area.
insider_tip: The downstairs sweet counter is the higher-volume operation — buy mithai by weight, eat upstairs only if you want full meals. Distinct from Mathura's older Brijwasi sweets brand.
signature_address: Shopping Arcade, Sadar Bazaar, Agra Cantt, Agra 282001
